name: Oakland West
note: Opened as Oakland West; neighbourhood activists got BART to correct the name to West Oakland in May 1988 (day not given: mid-month used).

name: Berkeley
note: Named Berkeley 1973-1996; the BART board voted in May 1996 to rename it Downtown Berkeley (day not given).

name: Pleasant Hill
note: BART board voted on 23 Sep 2010 to rename the station Pleasant Hill/Contra Costa Centre.

name: Civic Center
note: Renamed Civic Center/UN Plaza in 2005 (month not given: mid-year used).

name: Oakland City Center / 12th Street
note: Name changed to Oakland City Center/12th Street in Oct 1971 (before opening); renamed 12th Street Oakland City Center around 2008 (ESTIMATE: 'c. 2008').

name: Coliseum
note: Opened as Coliseum; the airport was added to the name when the AirBART bus began on 1 Jul 1977.

name: Coliseum / Oakland Airport
note: Coliseum/Oakland Airport 1977-2014; back to Coliseum when the Oakland Airport Connector (with its own Oakland International Airport station) opened on 22 Nov 2014.
